definition: The compact band of projection fibers between the caudate and thalamus medially and the lentiform nucleus laterally, with an anterior limb (frontopontine and anterior thalamic radiation), a genu (corticobulbar), a posterior limb (corticospinal and sensory thalamocortical fibers), and retrolenticular and sublenticular parts (optic and acoustic radiations). Lacunes here produce pure motor or sensorimotor stroke.
